summary: Your nineteenth teach-back. You answer a colleague who asks why an SLO is needed on top of a response-time dashboard, explain SLI versus SLO in 5 sentences with a number from your own system, check six key points, and test your explanation against the real numbers: an SLI of 95% with the cold start and 100% after the warm-up.

items.text: Write what you would answer the colleague and one thing an average response time hides
